bookTitle: Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets (John J. Murphy)
subject: finance

trendline.definition: A bounding straight line drawn across key support or resistance pivot levels.

support.definition: A price level where demand is thought to be strong enough to prevent the price from declining further.

resistance.definition: A price level where selling pressure is thought to be strong enough to prevent the price from rising further.

persona.contextDescription: NSE equity charts, candlesticks, moving averages, and classic chart patterns.
